chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from al-'Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from al-Ya'qubi, from Musa ibn 'Isa, from Muhammad ibn Muyassir, from Harun ibn al-Jahm, from al-Sukuni, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “When the deceased dies at the beginning of the day, he should not take the midday rest except in his grave.”

key_terms.فَلَا يَقِيلُ: then he should not take the midday rest

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about promptly burying a deceased person who dies early in the day?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys the urgency of burying the deceased without unnecessary delay, especially when death occurs early in the day. It reflects the prophetic tradition of prompt funeral arrangements and points to the immediacy of the transition from worldly life to the grave.
